name: Camp Gordyland (Wilton Family YMCA)
description_short: Camp Gordyland is the summer camp at the Wilton branch of the Riverbrook Regional YMCA. Campers with special needs join a regular camp group, and the Special Needs Director may assign them shared paraprofessional support.
special_needs_notes: Campers with special needs take part fully in their camp group and in all camp-day activities. At the Special Needs Director's discretion, a camper may be assigned shared (not one-to-one) paraprofessional support. Support staff help with engagement and make modifications when needed. Students in summer school can attend, and the Y will work around school district schedules. CIT program can extend beyond age 16 up to age 21 if space allows. Campers registered as an extension of a school-supported program must attend with district support. The Y may require families to provide outside support, and the Special Needs Director or Camp Director will contact the family to agree on a plan. Families must contact Christina Foley (cfoley@riverbrookymca.org, 203-762-8384 ext. 207) to discuss needs or arrange support staff. Full sessions go to a waitlist.
